forbidden_temporal_inferences: Do not synthesize robin_first_observed_at from filesystem mtime, Git commit/author time, row order, match date or kickoff.
Do not equate source lastUpdated, forecast valid time or model initialization with public availability without documented semantics and a receipt.
Do not treat opening/closing labels as exact observation timestamps.
Do not treat an export receipt, manifest hash or external object key as a source-data receipt.
Do not use realized weather or reanalysis as forecast-as-known information.
Do not upgrade RECONSTRUCTED_NOT_PROVEN data to point-in-time evidence.

source_name.rule: canonical logical product, not merely publisher

source_url.rule: official endpoint/documented object URL; no secret/query credential

request_identity.rule: canonical method, path and sorted non-secret parameters/headers sufficient to replay

payload_sha256.rule: hash exact immutable response bytes before parsing

source_published_at.rule: only trusted provider-defined publication/update semantics; null otherwise

robin_first_observed_at.rule: set at receipt of response bytes by Robin-controlled clock; immutable

robin_ingested_at.rule: time immutable bytes and receipt are durably admitted

available_at.rule: max(trusted source_published_at when present, robin_first_observed_at); never earlier than either

capture_code_revision.rule: immutable Git commit or content digest of capture code

licence_status.rule: versioned legal decision linked to reviewed terms

snapshot_candidate_id.rule: collision-resistant deterministic ID bound to source/request/payload/first-observed

invariants: payload_sha256 must match stored immutable bytes.
available_at >= source_published_at when source_published_at is non-null and trusted.
An observation is admissible only when available_at <= feature_cutoff_at.
Missing or untrusted availability fields fail closed.
A later payload for the same request creates a new snapshot_candidate_id; it never overwrites an earlier receipt.

acceptance_criteria_for_any_future_histo: The scoped observation denominator is fixed.
Every admitted source item has byte-exact payload and receipt verification.
request_identity and capture_code_revision are immutable and replayable.
available_at is no later than the decision/feature cutoff for every joined observation.
All absent, external-unobserved and lost items are recovered or explicitly excluded.
Representative point-in-time replay yields identical hashes and features with zero future-mutation defects.
